## Problem Statement

A clear description of what problem this feature solves.
Ex: "I want to switch layouts without going back to the designer screen..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be specific about behavior and UI.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternatives you've considered.

## Use Case

Who benefits from this feature and how?

## Additional Context

Add sketches, mockups, or references to similar features in other apps.
